title: Avoid lines......
text: This is a must see, but not an easy see in Barcelona. Our guide was excellent. He walked us past long lines, moved us to notable sections, shared knowledge of the structure and artists, answered all questions in detail. Excellent excursion.
author: Lorene_R

title: Loved the experience
text: Overall great experience other than the fact that Victor gave the wrong name for the mtg point. We eventually found our guide, Alex who was wonderful, fun, and super informative. A great way to see this masterwork!
author: Susan_W

title: A must see!
text: The colors and story are incredible. To think this masterpiece was started over 100 years ago and still is not complete is awe-inspiring.
author: Angela_V
